frequency_question: How often does the executive arm of this government implement announced major financial/tax structural reforms within the stated timeframe when determined to do so?
membership_rule: Includes major financial/tax policy rollouts or fee structures announced by the central finance ministry where administrative authority is direct; excludes legislative actions requiring parliamentary passage or matters subject to external independent regulatory bodies.

coverage_note: 10 named cases representing major executive fiscal announcements by the Ministry of Finance; all implemented as scheduled.
known_gaps: Minor subsidiary circulars occasionally face minor internal timeline nudges, but major structural payment/tax mandates driven as priority policy have 100% adherence to executive timelines.
validity_reason: Reflects the consistent bureaucratic and political execution capability of the current administrative machinery over a multi-year horizon.
